quotations.projectAddress: Juggles Joint, Highfield Farm, West Willoughby, Lincolnshire, NG32 3SJ
quotations.projectDescription: Drone photogrammetry survey, existing elevations, outline plan and whitecard 3D blockout model of the stone barn at Highfield Farm, to test its division into three homes. This work is a favour, so the total is £0. It still runs through the normal quotation system for two reasons. The hours are allocated in-house, so this job has a fixed budget of 40 hours within my schedule alongside every other project. And the value of the work is on record: each hour is priced at the full rate, and the Friends & Family Discount at the foot removes the whole amount. Anything beyond this scope would be quoted separately.

lineItems.itemDescription:
1. On-site drone photogrammetry survey on 26-Sep-2026, including travel.
2. Temporary ground control points set out on site. These are not tied to any fixed site datum.
lineItems.group: Building Survey : Feasibility Survey & Blockout Model

lineItems.itemDescription:
1. Processing the drone images into a textured 3D survey model.
2. Scaling and aligning the model to the temporary control points.
lineItems.group: Building Survey : Feasibility Survey & Blockout Model
